changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE open_accounts DROP INDEX uq_open_accounts_active_owner, ADD COLUMN active_open_branch_id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS ( CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' AND enabled = TRUE THEN branch_id ELSE NULL END ) STORED, ADD CONSTRAINT uq_open_accounts_active_owner_branch UNIQUE (active_open_owner_id, active_open_branch_id)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE open_accounts DROP INDEX uq_open_accounts_active_owner_branch, DROP COLUMN active_open_branch_id, ADD CONSTRAINT uq_open_accounts_active_owner UNIQUE (active_open_owner_id)
